---
title: "Cisplatin_GC_Vehicle_WeightedEnsemble_Annotation"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-04-22"
output: html_document
description: |
  Weighted ensemble annotation combining five L1 cell-type predictions:
    1. Seurat Transfer (MKA reference)   — L1_SeuratMKA
    2. Seurat Transfer (Lake reference)  — L1_SeuratLake
    3. Manual / Raw annotation           — L1_Raw
    4. scANVI (MKA reference)            — L1_scanviMKA
    5. scANVI (Lake reference)           — L1_scanviLake

  Each method's vote is weighted by method_weight × per-cell confidence score.
  The label with the highest total weighted score is the final call.

  Input : Cisplatin_GC_Vehicle_Reclustered_MarkerAnnot_L1Harmonised_NoVehGC_Annotation.RDS
  Output: Cisplatin_GC_Vehicle_Reclustered_MarkerAnnot_L1Harmonised_NoVehGC_Weighted_Annotation.RDS
          (WeightedAnnotation, WeightedAnnotation_score, WeightedAnnotation_margin added)
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(ggsci)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1e15)
```

```{r dirs}
setwd(OutDir)
```

# Read L1-harmonised object

```{r read}
CisplatinGCObj <- readRDS(
  paste0(AnnDir, "Cisplatin_GC_Vehicle_Reclustered_MarkerAnnot_L1Harmonised_NoVehGC_Annotation.RDS")
)

# Quick check: confirm all required columns are present
required_cols <- c(
  "L1_SeuratMKA",  "Seaurat_Transfer_Predicted_MKA.max",
  "L1_SeuratLake", "Seaurat_Transfer_Predicted_Lake.max",
  "L1_Raw",        "Raw_cell_type_Confidence",
  "L1_scanviMKA",  "scanvi_MKA_confidence",
  "L1_scanviLake", "scanvi_Lake_confidence"
)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(CisplatinGCObj@meta.data))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns in metadata: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

CisplatinGCObj@meta.data[, required_cols] %>% head()
```

# Define weights and confidence score mappings

```{r weights}
# Equal weights: each method contributes equally, as no published benchmark
# directly comparing all five methods on mouse kidney data is available.
method_weights <- c(
  L1_SeuratMKA  = 0.20,
  L1_SeuratLake = 0.20,
  L1_Raw        = 0.20,
  L1_scanviMKA  = 0.20,
  L1_scanviLake = 0.20
)
stopifnot(abs(sum(method_weights) - 1) < 1e-9)
cat("Method weights:\n"); print(method_weights)

# Per-cell confidence score column for each method
method_score_cols <- c(
  L1_SeuratMKA  = "Seaurat_Transfer_Predicted_MKA.max",
  L1_SeuratLake = "Seaurat_Transfer_Predicted_Lake.max",
  L1_Raw        = "Raw_cell_type_Confidence",
  L1_scanviMKA  = "scanvi_MKA_confidence",
  L1_scanviLake = "scanvi_Lake_confidence"
)
```

# Build weighted score matrix and assign labels

```{r weighted-ensemble}
# Min-max normalise a numeric vector to [0, 1].
# Constant columns (e.g. Raw_cell_type_Confidence = 1 for all cells) return 1
# so they still contribute their full method weight uniformly.
normalize_01 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0
  r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (diff(r) < 1e-10) return(rep(1.0, length(x)))
  (x - r[1]) / (r[2] - r[1])
}

meta <- CisplatinGCObj@meta.data

# Show pre-normalisation score distributions so scale differences are visible
cat("Raw confidence score ranges (before normalisation):\n")
for (method in names(method_weights)) {
  sc <- as.numeric(meta[[method_score_cols[method]]])
  cat(sprintf("  %-40s min=%.3f  median=%.3f  max=%.3f\n",
              method_score_cols[method], min(sc, na.rm=TRUE),
              median(sc, na.rm=TRUE), max(sc, na.rm=TRUE)))
}

# Collect every L1 label observed across all five methods (excluding "Uncertain")
all_labels <- sort(unique(na.omit(unlist(
  lapply(names(method_weights), function(m) {
    v <- meta[[m]]
    v[!is.na(v) & v != "Uncertain"]
  })
))))
cat("L1 labels in ensemble:", paste(all_labels, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Initialise score matrix: rows = cells, cols = L1 labels
n_cells      <- nrow(meta)
score_matrix <- matrix(0.0, nrow = n_cells, ncol = length(all_labels),
                       dimnames = list(rownames(meta), all_labels))

for (method in names(method_weights)) {
  labels   <- meta[[method]]
  # Normalise to [0,1] before weighting so scores from different methods
  # are on a comparable scale before the method_weight is applied
  scores   <- normalize_01(meta[[method_score_cols[method]]])

  w        <- method_weights[method]
  weighted <- w * scores

  valid    <- !is.na(labels) & labels != "Uncertain" & labels %in% all_labels
  rows     <- which(valid)
  cols     <- match(labels[valid], all_labels)

  # Vectorised accumulation via linear matrix index
  lin_idx  <- rows + (cols - 1L) * n_cells
  score_matrix[lin_idx] <- score_matrix[lin_idx] + weighted[rows]
}

# Final label: column with maximum weighted score per cell
row_max  <- apply(score_matrix, 1, max)
best_col <- max.col(score_matrix, ties.method = "first")

# Runner-up score — difference = decision margin (higher = more certain)
second_max <- apply(score_matrix, 1, function(r) {
  s <- sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(s) >= 2L) s[2L] else 0
})

CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$WeightedAnnotation        <- ifelse(row_max == 0, "Uncertain",
                                                             all_labels[best_col])
CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$WeightedAnnotation_score  <- row_max
CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$WeightedAnnotation_margin <- row_max - second_max

cat("Weighted ensemble annotation distribution:\n")
print(table(CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$WeightedAnnotation, useNA = "always"))
```

# Per-cell score summary

```{r score-summary}
score_summary <- CisplatinGCObj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(WeightedAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells     = n(),
    mean_score  = round(mean(WeightedAnnotation_score),  3),
    mean_margin = round(mean(WeightedAnnotation_margin), 3),
    pct_high_conf = round(100 * mean(WeightedAnnotation_score > 0.5), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cells))

cat("Score summary per cell type:\n")
print(score_summary, n = Inf)

write.csv(score_summary,
          file = paste0(OutDir, "WeightedAnnotation_ScoreSummary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Cluster-level dominant label

```{r cluster-summary}
weighted_cluster_summary <- CisplatinGCObj@meta.data %>%
  select(Sub2, WeightedAnnotation, WeightedAnnotation_score, WeightedAnnotation_margin) %>%
  group_by(Sub2, WeightedAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells     = n(),
    mean_score  = round(mean(WeightedAnnotation_score),  3),
    mean_margin = round(mean(WeightedAnnotation_margin), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sub2) %>%
  slice_max(n_cells, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Dominant weighted label per cluster:\n")
print(weighted_cluster_summary, n = Inf)

write.csv(weighted_cluster_summary,
          file = paste0(OutDir, "Cluster_WeightedAnnotation_Summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Add ClusterMajority: simple unweighted plurality vote across the five L1 methods
# (no confidence scores, just which label appears most often per cell, then
#  the cluster-level dominant label is the mode of those per-cell votes)
label_cols <- names(method_weights)   # L1_SeuratMKA, L1_SeuratLake, L1_Raw, L1_scanviMKA, L1_scanviLake

CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$MajorityVote <- apply(
  CisplatinGCObj@meta.data[, label_cols], 1,
  function(row) {
    votes <- row[!is.na(row) & row != "Uncertain"]
    if (length(votes) == 0) return("Uncertain")
    names(sort(table(votes), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  }
)

cluster_majority_map <- CisplatinGCObj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Sub2, MajorityVote) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sub2) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Sub2, ClusterMajority = MajorityVote)

# Use match instead of left_join to preserve Seurat metadata rownames
CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$ClusterMajority <- cluster_majority_map$ClusterMajority[
  match(CisplatinGCObj@meta.data$Sub2, cluster_majority_map$Sub2)
]

CisplatinGCObj@meta.data %>% head()
```

# Comparison: weighted ensemble vs. cluster majority vote

```{r compare-majority}
if ("ClusterMajority" %in% colnames(CisplatinGCObj@meta.data)) {
  comparison <- CisplatinGCObj@meta.data %>%
    select(Sub2, WeightedAnnotation, ClusterMajority) %>%
    group_by(Sub2) %>%
    summarise(
      WeightedAnnotation = names(sort(table(WeightedAnnotation), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      ClusterMajority    = ClusterMajority[1],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Concordant = WeightedAnnotation == ClusterMajority)

  cat("Weighted ensemble vs. cluster majority vote:\n")
  print(comparison, n = Inf)
  cat("Concordant clusters:", sum(comparison$Concordant), "/", nrow(comparison), "\n")

  write.csv(comparison,
            file = paste0(OutDir, "WeightedAnnotation_vs_ClusterMajority.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("ClusterMajority column not found — skipping comparison.\n")
}
```

```{r barplot-score}
df_score <- CisplatinGCObj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(WeightedAnnotation) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(WeightedAnnotation_score),
            sd_score   = sd(WeightedAnnotation_score),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(WeightedAnnotation != "Uncertain") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_score))

p_bar <- ggplot(df_score, aes(x = reorder(WeightedAnnotation, -mean_score),
                               y = mean_score, fill = WeightedAnnotation)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_score - sd_score,
                    ymax = mean_score + sd_score), width = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_d3(palette = "category20") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mean weighted score ± SD per cell type",
       x = NULL, y = "Mean weighted score") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave(paste0(OutDir, "WeightedAnnotation_MeanScore_Bar.pdf"),
       plot = p_bar, height = 4, width = 6)
p_bar
```
